_about: Which entries in a /players/{tag} 'troops' list are pets or siege machines, and which are super troops (boosted copies of a base troop, left out of the troops category). The API puts all of them in one list with no type field. A name not listed here counts as a troop. Village 'home' only.
source: Pets and siege machines: the lists Ka Wai approved for the Explore design on 1 Nov 2026. Super troops: Claude's knowledge of the game, not checked against a live response. Check the first real profile pass: any name that lands in the wrong category needs adding here.
